title: Add new Property Gallery image for “High Capacity 26 Passenger Lifts” after Terrace/Rooftop

requirements.text: Add the uploaded image as a new static asset in the frontend and reference it from the Property Gallery.

quotes: can you include this image under property gallery but after terrace/rooftop with the heading of High Capacity 26 Passenger Lifts

acceptanceCriteria: A new image file exists under frontend/public/assets/generated with the exact filename specified in the image requirements.
The app loads the new image via a /assets/generated/... path without any backend changes.
The image renders correctly in the browser (no broken image link).

requirements.text: Update the Property Gallery list to include a new gallery card immediately after the existing “Terrace / Rooftop” item, with the visible label text set to “High Capacity 26 Passenger Lifts”.

quotes: include this image under property gallery but after terrace/rooftop with the heading of High Capacity 26 Passenger Lifts

acceptanceCriteria: In the gallery UI, the new item appears directly after the “Terrace / Rooftop” item.
The card’s displayed heading/label is exactly “High Capacity 26 Passenger Lifts”.
The new gallery item includes appropriate alt text describing the image content (in English).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep the backend unchanged (no new Motoko methods/state) for this gallery-only update.
nonGoals: Adding new backend APIs or storing gallery items in the backend.
Changing the overall gallery layout, styling, or adding new sections beyond the single requested gallery item.

required: Uploaded photo of two elevator doors in a modern lobby (high-capacity-26-passenger-lifts.dim_1536x1024.png)
